name: SK Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: SK Securities Co., Ltd., a financial investment firm founded in Seoul, South Korea, in 1955, delivers a comprehensive array of financial solutions. Its primary services encompass thorough asset management and conventional investment banking. The company also specializes in advising on and arranging real estate project financing (PF), in addition to the securitization of tangible assets. It provides diverse investment opportunities across fixed income, equities, and derivatives. Furthermore, SK Securities undertakes the underwriting of equities, bonds, and equity-related bonds, offers structured securities, Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) financial products, and extends M&A advisory and investment services. The firm's consulting expertise spans alternative investments, equity strategies, new renewable energy PF, certified emissions reduction, and ESG bond issuance. Moreover, it operates a digital financial platform that facilitates mobile-only account openings, CMA, various funds, over-the-counter bonds, and robo-advisory services.
